title: RentGuard Contents Settlement Figures by Tier
content:
Two tier figures of the RentGuard Renters Policy govern how a contents loss is paid out over time: the replacement-cost amount at or below which a contents loss is paid at full replacement cost with no depreciation withheld, and the number of calendar days after the actual-cash-value payment within which replaced items must be documented to recover withheld depreciation.

| Tier | Full replacement cost paid without withholding, for a loss at or below (USD) | Depreciation recovery period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 0 | 180 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 0 | 180 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 500 | 180 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 1000 | 365 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 1500 | 365 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 2500 | 365 |

## Claims-manual notes

- HO-4 Starter and HO-4 Essential settle contents on actual cash value; their no-withholding figure is 0.
- The no-withholding figure is compared with the replacement-cost value of the property class paid. On a hypothetical RentGuard HO-4 Premier claim, a class with a replacement-cost value of exactly 1000 is at the figure and is paid at full replacement cost, while 1000.01 is above it.
- The recovery period is 180 calendar days on the three lower tiers and 365 calendar days on HO-4 Premier, HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature.
